_note: Official registers ShelterKart reads, their licences and the credit each report shows (blind-spot review #6). Licence names come from the notes recorded in engine/registry.js; 'confirmed' stays false until a lawyer confirms each licence's attribution wording. 'hosts' are the addresses whose pages identify the register in a report.
